body.statement: For every optimizer \(\gamma^{\star}\in\Gamma(\mathbf P)\), \(\operatorname{diam}\{\sum_{k=1}^Kz_k:(z_1,\ldots,z_K)\in\operatorname{supp}(\gamma^{\star})\}\le2\sqrt r\); the constant is attained when \(K\ge d\) by orthogonal symmetric two-point margins.
body.justification: This support theorem is the shared geometry needed to localize all dual potentials at once.
body.gap: Gao--Ge--Qian exchange one coordinate and obtain a \(\sqrt K\)-scale control; no located source gives the sharp fixed-dimensional diameter for this repulsive sum cost.
body.consumer: The empirical-process upper bound uses the diameter to normalize dual slopes by \(K^{-2}\sqrt r\).
